sloka: नम उग्राय वीराय सारङ्गाय नमो नमः ।नमः पद्मप्रबोधाय मार्ताण्डाय नमो नमः ।। ६.१०७.१८ ।।
transliteration: nama ugrāya vīrāya sāraṅgāya namo namaḥ ।namaḥ padmaprabodhāya mārtāṇḍāya namo namaḥ ।। 6.107.18 ।।

translations.english: "Hail to you of terrible form, of valiant one, denoted by the syllable 'AUM'. Namaskar to the awakener of lotuses. Namaskar to the fierce one.
